claims: Emma Stone has won two Academy Awards for Best Actress.
Emma Stone won an Academy Award for Best Actress for La La Land (2017).
Emma Stone won an Academy Award for Best Actress for Poor Things (2024).
As of March 2026, Emma Stone has received five total acting Oscar nominations.
Emma Stone is recognized as one of the youngest women to achieve seven total Oscar nominations.
Emma Stone's seven total Oscar nominations include best picture nods.
Emma Stone won Best Actress for her role as Mia Dolan in La La Land (2017).
La La Land (2017) is a musical romance.
Emma Stone won Best Actress for her role as Bella Baxter in Poor Things (2024).
Poor Things (2024) is a dark comedy fantasy.
Emma Stone was nominated for Best Supporting Actress for Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance) (2015).
Emma Stone was nominated for Best Supporting Actress for The Favourite (2019).
Emma Stone was nominated for Best Picture (Producer) for Poor Things (2024).
